metadata.computation_basis: Lookup MSC from salary range, then apply contribution amounts from `sss_brackets` (or MSC-based 5% EE + 10% ER + EC when columns absent). Total regular SS is 15% of MSC since January 2025 — never apply percentages to raw basic salary.
